permissions.description: Expense claims, their approval, and the payroll export

actions.description: The caller's own claims and their receipts
Create, correct and send the caller's own claims
Take back one of the caller's own claims that is not yet decided
Claims submitted by employees sharing a directory group with the caller, and the decision on them
Run a payroll export and download it

groups.name: Managers
groups.description: Those who decide their team's expense claims

groups.name: Finance
groups.description: Those who export approved claims to payroll

roles.name: Employee
roles.description: Files expense claims, tracks them, withdraws one before it is decided, and corrects one that was rejected.

roles.name: Manager
roles.description: The Manager actor: files their own claims like any employee, and decides the claims submitted by employees sharing their directory groups.

roles.name: PayrollExporter
roles.description: The Finance actor: sees every approved claim and exports a period's worth for payroll.
